questions.question: When King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army, what did he do to the city?
After King Zedekiah of Judah was caught fleeing Jerusalem, where did the Chaldeans bring him to Nebuchadnezzar?

answers.text: To Riblah in the land of Hamath
To Lachish in the land of Judah

questions.question: What did King Nebuchadnezzar order his captain Nebuzaradan to do about the prophet Jeremiah?

answers.text: Look after him and let no harm come to him
Take him to Babylon in bronze chains
Keep him locked in the courtyard of the guard

questions.question: Why did the LORD promise to rescue Ebed-melech the Cushite from the sword when Jerusalem fell?

answers.text: Because he trusted in the LORD
Because he served the king well
Because he left the city early
